name: Covariance Factorisation
aliases: Covariance Factorisation — RQ Decomposition for Covariance, Rotation and Scale Parameterization
definition: A parameterization of the 3D Gaussian covariance matrix by factorizing it into a rotation and a scale, ensuring the covariance remains positive semi-definite under unconstrained gradient descent.
summary: Covariance Factorisation decomposes the 3D Gaussian covariance matrix into unconstrained rotation and scale components, enabling stable gradient-based optimization without requiring projection steps to enforce positive semi-definiteness.
